statements.query: select count(*) from (select s.id,s.id seat_id,s.room_id,s.code,s.has_power,r.name room_name,r.code room_code,b.name building_name,c.name campus_name,r.building_id,b.campus_id,$1 available from core.room r join core.seat s on s.room_id=r.id and s.enabled join core.building b on b.id=r.building_id and b.enabled join core.campus c on c.id=b.campus_id and c.enabled join core.app_user u on u.id=$2 where r.enabled and (r.department_id is null or r.department_id=u.department_id) and not exists(select $3 from generate_series($4($2 as timestamptz),$5($3 as timestamptz)-interval $6,interval $7) requested_hour where not exists(select $8 from core.opening_rule opening where opening.room_id=r.id and opening.weekday=extract($9 from requested_hour at time zone $10) and opening.start_minute<=extract($11 from requested_hour at time zone $12)*$13 and opening.end_minute>=(extract($14 from requested_hour at time zone $15)+$16)*$17)) and not exists(select $18 from core.resource_claim claim where claim.room_id=r.id and (claim.seat_id is null or claim.seat_id=s.id) and claim.released_at is null and claim.start_at<$19 and (claim.end_at is null or claim.end_at>$20)) and not exists(select $21 from core.reservation own where own.user_id=$22 and own.status in($23 /*, ... */) and own.start_at<$24 and own.end_at>$25) order by r.code,s.code) page_count
